entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return for a helmet.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color isn't what I expected. The box is still unopened. I just need to know if I can send it back.

I completely understand. Getting the right color is important, especially for your main safety gear. Let me just pull up your account... I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet was delivered about 30 days ago, is that correct?
Yes. So can I return it or not?

Absolutely. Since the box is unopened and you're well within our 90-day return policy, this is no problem at all. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file for you.
Okay, great. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
